description: Move read traffic from the primary PostgreSQL 14 instance to read replicas. The primary handles ~15,000 reads/second during peak. Migration must: provision 2 read replicas in different AZs, configure PgBouncer connection pooling with read/write split rules, verify replica lag < 100ms, slowly drain read traffic from primary to replicas (10% → 50% → 100% over 4 hours), monitor for stale-read issues, and verify failover behavior if a replica goes down. Risk factors: replication lag causing stale reads, long-running transactions blocking replication, application assuming read-after-write consistency. Tools available: PgBouncer, HAProxy, psql, Prometheus, Grafana.
